_doc: Tunables for the balancing simulator's party policies (game/battle/sim/, docs/kb/design/balance_targets.md). Not game data: nothing in play reads this file. loadouts: the gear (equipment ids per character) and consumables a suite's party carries (balance_targets.md, Party assumptions). swell_heal_below_pct (M2-CMB-01): a ready healing Swell technique waits until an active ally is below this share of max HP. call_vowbound (M2-CMB-05): when a policy calls the actor's Vowbound: at_once (the masher) or field_up (only while a field is up); absent = never. Loadout flags bind the Vowbound (vowbound.json bound_flag). retire_skills (M2-FP-17): skills a loadout takes off the party (ch03_drownbell retires the call_ilun stand-in, so the policies play the real Vowbound call). flood_call: the naive_swell masher who calls the Vowbound when a field rises. dismiss_when_clear (M2-FP-17): the Vowbound goes home on its own turn once no field is up.
